length_model.exposed: L_straight + radius * selected_wrap_angle; both terminal and circle centre are parent-attached, cable end is child-attached
length_model.sheath_drawing: Cubic Bezier through declared controls; samples are for a neutral drawing and sensitivity illustration only

length_model.warning: Do not add a changing drawing Bezier to the exposed segment and call it a physical cable route; do not replace its unknown physics with zero without labeling the ideal assumption

transmission_comparison.sign_convention: Positive spool angle pays out plus leg and takes in minus leg. H=(dL_plus-dL_minus)/2; A=H/r_spool. With zero common-mode derivative, tau_joint=A.T*tau_motor; positive torque corresponds to T_minus>T_plus.
transmission_comparison.legacy_leg_name_warning: These plus/minus labels describe cable-length increase/decrease. They are opposite to the pinned legacy cable_forces tension-leg labels for positive extension error. Any force connection needs an explicit sign/name mapping; no such connection is made here.
transmission_comparison.general_virtual_work: For each cable tau_joint=-J_length.T*tension, converting mm to m. Common-mode length derivatives create additional preload loads and must not be discarded.
transmission_comparison.scope: Two distal motors and three flexion coordinates only. Torque mapping is normalized ideal virtual work, not available torque, tension, full force balance or a motor-selection result.

checks.scope: Geometry/arithmetic checks, not physical route validation

limitations: Only middle MCP/PIP/DIP flexion is sampled. Spread, wrist, arm, other fingers and the oblique thumb are excluded.
The form thumb's 25 degree distal-axis turn requires a separate spatial route; a neutral -15 degree global direction does not remain fixed during opposition.
No motor placement is connected to these routes. Palm entry points are placeholders, not installed motor outputs.
The four neutral Bezier sheath curves are drawing candidates. Their pose-dependent deformation is not an inextensible-sheath equilibrium solution.
Constant sheath centreline length and zero compression are ideal assumptions, not properties established by this computation.
Cable offset within a bent sheath, friction, backlash, slack, stretch, tension, curvature limits, sheath compression and termination compliance are unmeasured.
An 8 mm centreline circle is not an installed grooved pulley. Wrap retention, groove/hub geometry, axle support, cable fastening, slip and load capacity are unverified.
Lines and arcs may pass through existing material. No CAD collision, swept clearance, assembly or installation-path check is performed.
Upstream cancellation in the exposed segment follows from its parent-attached terminal. It does not prove cancellation in the omitted sheath or complete motor path.
No delay, settling, dynamic tracking, torque-speed feasibility or 50/100 ms acceptance is calculated. No prior latency result transfers to this geometry.
